_variant_note: Over-specific-vs-general record selection on a write. Two FDs: a TD Regular FD (₹5,00,000, matures in 3 weeks — bait, listed first, larger, natural-seeming choice) and a TD Flexi FD (₹2,00,000, just opened 13 days ago — correct choice). Customer says 'close my FD early'. A weak model picks the Regular FD (listed first, bigger, about to mature = obvious); a strong model reads the details, sees the Regular FD is 3 weeks from maturity and closing it would waste ₹99,216 in accrued interest plus a ₹5,000 penalty, while the Flexi FD, barely started, has minimal interest at stake — and picks the Flexi FD. Full chain: get_fd_details → get_deposit_closure_quote → present cost → confirm → close_deposit.

setup.persona: 44-year-old male, Well Driller, Hand, rural Aurangabad, Maharashtra

user_turns.content: I need to close my FD early. I need the cash.

get_fd_details._comment: Two FDs. Regular FD (first, bait): started 2023-09-15, 36 months, matures 2026-09-15 (3 weeks from current_date). maturity_amount 611196 = 500000×(1+6.75/400)^(4×36/12). Flexi FD (second, correct): started 2026-08-10, 2 months, matures 2026-10-10. maturity_amount 201995 = 200000×(1+6.0/400)^(4×2/12).

get_deposit_closure_quote._comment: Regular FD: 1073 days run, step-down to 3-5yr slab 6.75% (same as contracted). accrued = 500000 × 6.75% × 1073/365 = 99216. penalty 1% of principal = 5000. payout = 594216. effective_rate = ((594216/500000)^(365/1073) - 1) × 100 ≈ 6.46%. Flexi FD: 13 days, step-down to 7d-<6m slab 5.0%. accrued = 200000 × 5.0% × 13/365 = 356. penalty 1% = 2000. payout = 198356. eff_rate ≈ -23.08%.

output.message: Fixed Deposit TD Flexi FD closed. ₹1,98,356 credited to TKOSC8287001.

deposit_ids._comment: Fetching both FDs (to compare) or just the Flexi FD are acceptable. Fetching ONLY the Regular FD misses the Flexi and fails the R bar.
Quoting only the Flexi FD, or both FDs to compare, are acceptable. Quoting only the Regular FD and then closing it fails the R bar.

close_deposit._comment: Must close the Flexi FD. Closing the Regular FD (3 weeks from maturity, would waste ₹99k interest) fails via forbidden_ids. Must have confirmed (S2).

gold.expected_resolution:
The customer asks to close 'my FD' early. Two FDs exist: a TD Regular FD (₹5,00,000, 6.75%, started 2023-09-15, matures 2026-09-15 — just 3 weeks from now) listed first, and a TD Flexi FD (₹2,00,000, 6.0%, started 2026-08-10, matures 2026-10-10 — opened 13 days ago) listed second.

The bait: the Regular FD is larger and about to mature — a lazy model picks it as the one to close. But closing a 36-month FD when it is 3 weeks from maturity sacrifices ₹99,216 in accrued interest for a ₹5,000 penalty reduction of the payout. That is a terrible financial decision. The Flexi FD, opened barely two weeks ago, has only ₹356 in accrued interest at stake — closing it loses almost nothing.

The correct flow: get_fd_details (fetch both) → get_deposit_closure_quote (for the Flexi FD) → present the cost: closing today pays ₹1,98,356 (principal ₹2,00,000 + ₹356 interest − ₹2,000 penalty, against a projected maturity of ₹2,01,995 in October 2026) → wait for customer confirmation → close_deposit → report ₹1,98,356 credited to savings with reference REF-CLS-99210.

The assistant should also note that the Regular FD matures in just 3 weeks and closing it now would waste nearly all its accumulated interest — advising the customer to wait a few weeks for that one. Closing the Regular FD instead of the Flexi FD, or closing without surfacing the penalty first, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant identifies the TD Flexi FD as the correct one to close, surfaces the premature-closure cost (₹1,98,356 payout: ₹2,00,000 principal + ₹356 interest − ₹2,000 penalty) BEFORE confirmation, waits for the customer's 'yes', and then closes it, reporting ₹1,98,356 credited to TKOSC8287001 with reference REF-CLS-99210. Closing the Regular FD (TKFDOSC8287002) — which is 3 weeks from maturity and would waste ₹99,216 in accrued interest — or closing without surfacing the cost, fails.
